stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Job Agent 3.0.15 Beta adds Dashboard conversion metrics for confirmed submitted applications: recruiter response rate, interview rate and offer rate. All percentages use unique confirmed submissions as the denominator, ignore unsubmitted handoffs, handle empty history safely, and preserve existing response stages and manual safety rules. Updated regression tests and successful CI on the release source revision.
